job.title: Process Engineer - SMT Support
job.description:
The Process Engineer - SMT Support is responsible for developing, optimizing, and sustaining surface mount technology (SMT) manufacturing processes used in the production of broadcast and video transmission equipment.

Responsibilities:
  • Provide day-to-day engineering support for SMT production lines including stencil printing, SPI, pick-and-place, reflow soldering, AOI, and selective solder processes.
  • Develop, document, and maintain manufacturing processes, work instructions, machine programs, and setup standards.
  • Lead root cause investigations for yield, quality, and reliability issues using structured problem-solving techniques.
  • Optimize cycle times, throughput, setup reduction, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities including DFM reviews, process validation, pilot builds, and production ramp-up.
  • Analyze solder defects and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with Quality, Production, Test, Supply Chain, and Design Engineering teams.
  • Validate new SMT equipment, tooling, materials, and process changes through controlled experiments and qualification plans.
  • Develop process metrics and monitor yields, defects, scrap, rework, and productivity trends.
  • Ensure compliance with IPC standards and customer quality requirements.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, Mechanical, Electronics Engineering or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of SMT process engineering experience in electronics manufacturing.
  • Strong knowledge of SMT assembly equipment and PCB manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, and electronic assembly quality standards.
  • Ability to analyze process data and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Experience manufacturing professional broadcast, video transmission, RF, networking, or telecommunications products is an asset.  

What we offer:

  • Employer funded benefits program
  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Work-life balance
  • Employee Assistance plan
  • Employee Discount Platform

  • Casual work environment

job.title: Quality Specialist
job.description:
Responsibilities:
  • Perform incoming, in-process, and final inspection to IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001; review test and burn-in results; maintain calibration records
  • Investigate non-conformances, RMAs, and field failures (8D, 5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA); manage CAPAs and MRB activities
  • Maintain ISO 9001-aligned procedures, work instructions, and records; support internal and external audits
  • Support supplier qualification and scorecards; resolve supplier issues including counterfeit risk, obsolescence, and PCN/EOL notices
  • Participate in design reviews, DFM/DFT, and first article inspections; support qualification testing and compliance (CE, UL/CSA, FCC, RoHS, REACH, WEEE)
  • Analyze quality metrics (FPY, DPPM, RMA trends, COPQ) using SPC; support Lean and Six Sigma initiatives
Qualifications:
  • Diploma or degree in Electronics, Electrical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent experience)
  • 3-5 years of quality experience in electronics manufacturing
  • Working knowledge of ISO 9001, IPC standards, and PCB assembly (SMT and through-hole)
  • Experience with root cause analysis and CAPA
  • Ability to read schematics, assembly drawings, and BOMs
  • Strong analytical skills; proficient in Microsoft Office and ERP/QMS software
  • Experience in broadcast, pro A/V, telecom, or other high-reliability electronics is an asset
  • Internal or supplier auditing experience is an asset
  • IPC-A-610/J-STD-001 certification; ASQ certification (CQE, CQA, CQT) or Six Sigma Green/Black Belt is an asset
  • Knowledge of FMEA, SPC, MSA, Gauge R&R, and ESD control is an asset
